Nutrition Intervention Standardized Language: Domains and Examples
• Food and/or Nutrient Delivery
(ND): An individualized approach
for food/nutrient provision including
meals and snacks, enteral/
parenteral feeding, supplements,
assistance, environment, and
medication management
Examples: Modify distribution, type,
or amounts of food and nutrients
within meals or at speciﬁ ed times
(ND-1.1); initiate EN or PN (ND-2.1);
table service/set-up (ND-5.5)
• Nutrition Education (E): A for-
mal process to instruct or train a
patient/client in a skill or to impart 
knowledge to help patients/clients
to voluntarily manage or modify
food choices and eating behavior to
maintain or improve health
Examples: Priority modiﬁ cation 
(E-1.2), skill development (E-2.5)
• Nutrition Counseling (C): A 
supportive, collaborative process;
positive relationships that foster
responsibility for self-care to treat
an existing condition and promote
health
Examples: Health belief model
(C-1.3), motivational interviewing
(C-2.1), problem solving (C-2.4)
• Coordination of Nutrition Care
(RC): Consultation with, referral
to, or coordination of nutrition care
with other health care providers
that assists in treating nutrition-
related problems
Examples: Referral to RD with dif-
ferent expertise (RC-1.2), referral
to community agencies/programs
(RC-2.2)
